notes: v207: Better on iPad. Pinching the panels no longer zooms the whole page, tapping a money box no longer zooms in and gets stuck, and long-pressing the map or a button no longer brings up the text magnifier. Sound (phone rings, ATLAS and leader voices) now starts from your first tap and comes back after the iPad sleeps or takes a call. iPads are recognised as iPads in reports (Safari calls them a Mac).
